title: Lamb Adana Kebap Frites
description: French-inspired take on Turkish-style lamb kebap served with crispy frites.

ingredients.name: Lamb Adana Kebap
ingredients.notes: Available at local butcher or substitute with thinly sliced lamb shoulder

ingredients.name: Turkish Spice Mix
ingredients.notes: Comprised of cumin, coriander, and paprika

instructions: Season lamb with salt, pepper, and Turkish spice mix.
Grill lamb for 5-6 minutes per side, or until cooked to your liking.
Peel and cut potatoes into long strips for frites.
Heat vegetable oil in a deep frying pan to 350°F.
Fry potatoes in batches until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes.
Serve lamb strips with frites and a pat of butter.
Slice Turkish rye bread and serve on the side.
